selection: Only valid conflicting review pairs with no original adjudication file; excludes all failed, invalid, or completed original adjudications.
rubric: Correctness: 0 means wrong or unresolved, 1 means partial or insufficient, 2 means the supplied evidence supports the requested behavior. Side effects: 0 means a demonstrated serious regression, 1 means plausible risk or material uncertainty, 2 means no material regression identified in the supplied evidence. Use null for insufficient evidence. These are AI opinions about partial evidence, not project acceptance.
stopRule: Stop launching requests after a provider error or missing usage. Invalid output remains invalid.
limitations: Post-hoc model choice and selection after a timeout, not the original planned adjudication
Distinct AI model name through the same proxy; not independent human review
Short public issue histories and partial checks do not establish production value
